verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Intel's site serves an llms.txt file (HTTP 200) with a short company description, so an agent could point at it, but the content is generic corporate boilerplate rather than product-specific or deeply agent-oriented documentation, and no OpenAPI/agent-friendly API docs were found. Missing for 10: product-specific llms.txt content, structured agent-facing docs beyond the generic snippet, and a working openapi.json.
